content.title: Luke Combs Concert - Discover Ames
content.text: Skip to content Skip to content Luke Combs Concert Luke Combs will perform at Jack Trice Stadium in Ames, Iowa, on Saturday, April 11, 2026, as part of his “My Kinda Saturday Night” tour. He will be joined by special guests Dierks Bentley, Ty Myers, Jake Worthington, and Thelma & James. Date: Saturday, April 11, 2026 at Jack Trice Stadium, Ames, IA Special Guests: Dierks Bentley, Ty Myers, Jake Worthington, and Thelma & James Ticket Information: Pre-sale tickets began on October 14, 2025. General admission tickets went on sale starting October 17, 2025.
